page_title: WOL 0-1 FRE | Wolfsburg v Freiburg 26/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
90+3' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Freiburg, play can continue.

90+2' Play continues despite the shouts by some Freiburg players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Sven Jablonski interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+1' The ball possession at the moment is 42:58.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Wolfsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
87' The substitution has been made. Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) has replaced Ritsu Doan.
86' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' The referee signals a substitution. Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Bence Dardai.
78' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Jonas Wind will be replaced by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg).
78' Patrick Wimmer comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
76' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
75' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg).
73' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
72' Today's match ends for Lucas Holer who will be replaced by Johan Manzambi (Freiburg).
71' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Vincenzo Grifo and he is replaced by Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg).
71' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Max Rosenfelder is replaced by Lukas Kubler (Freiburg).
70' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
69' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) whips in a cross from the corner, but Florian Muller is well positioned and punches the ball away.
66' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
62' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
62' Kevin Paredes is substituted due to injury. Ralph Hasenhuttl gives a chance to Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg).
60' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) for his blatant foul.
58' Substitution. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) in, Mohamed Amoura out.
56' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
52' Florian Muller (Freiburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kamil Grabara, who smothers the ball.
49' 0 - 1 Goal! Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top left corner. He makes it 0:1.
47' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' Julian Schuster makes a switch. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is coming on in place of Junior Adamu at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
42' The linesman makes the right call and Freiburg will have a corner.
41' Referee Sven Jablonski halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Ralph Hasenhuttl, then shows him a yellow.
40' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is the one who receives a yellow card.
37' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
35' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
33' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) makes a rough challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
26' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) has to leave the pitch!
25' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he’s going to review that incident from earlier. It could result in a red card, but for who as a number of players were involved?
24' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
24' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Sven Jablonski and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
22' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
20' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
18' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
17' Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
17' It looks like Lucas Holer (Freiburg) saw red with that tackle. Sven Jablonski won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
15' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
14' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
12' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
8' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
7' One of the players from Wolfsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
5' The ball is cleared after Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

1' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Florian Muller!
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Wolfsburg will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Sven Jablonski.
